description: Purchased parts as datasheet-honest UHD definitions: research and cite the sources, author the ModuleDef, verify it automatically and by an independent audit, record the verification. Works on a project's parts (parts/local, parts/evidence) and on the cloud part library (library/parts).

skills.summary: UHD schema reference: model a module with UHD builders (interfaces, pin tables, buses, connectors, parameters, traits, package, geometry frames and refs); shipped by UHD
Find and cite sources (datasheets, CAD) for a purchased part before modelling it
Write a datasheet-honest UHD module definition from researched sources
Automated part checks, then an independent audit against the cited sources; record the verification

operations.summary: Automated checks for one local purchased part (metadata, citations, structure, parameters, vocabulary, connectors, pins, CAD) and pair DRC against mates; fails on any error

mate.description: comma-separated ids of mating parts for pair DRC

all.description: true: pair DRC against every other definition, reporting the pairs that connect

operations.summary: Write parts/evidence/<id>/verification.json from the audit and gaps in .research/ and the part's assumption traits

repairs.description: what was fixed after the audit

independent.description: true when an agent that did not author the part ran the audit, false for a self-audit (or set independent in .research/audit.json)

auditor.description: who ran the audit (default: audit.json's auditor)

method.description: how the audit checked the sources (default: audit.json's method)

tools.purpose: Python with build123d (CAD kernel the project's part-body scripts run on)
tools.install: protoboard tools install cad (a project venv with these pins), or point PROTOBOARD_PYTHON at an interpreter with build123d==0.13.0

capabilities.summary: A project-researched part's body drawn by its own build123d script (parts/local/<id>/part-cad/<script>.py): run, recorded and exported as STEP, GLB and a feature manifest

generate.summary: Run the part's script and record its digest, build123d version and feature signatures in part-cad/source.json; returns the bound signatures that differ

export.summary: Run the script again and write out/body.step, body.glb, body.manifest.json and out/interfaces/<id>.glb

extract.summary: The part's CAD artifacts that exist (its frames are the author's, from the drawing)

check.summary: The script is the one generate ran, and out/ was exported from that run

generator.description: file name of the build123d script in part-cad/ (required)
